declaration.preface: At True-Up Companies, we recognize that our success is built on the dedication and well-being of the people who power our business from our employees to the workers within our supply chain. We are committed to upholding the highest standards of Labor rights and human dignity in every aspect of our online retail operations. Our Labor and Human Rights Policy ensures fair wages, safe working conditions, and respect for fundamental human rights across our workforce and supplier network. We stand firmly against forced Labor, child Labor, discrimination, and any form of exploitation. By embedding these values into our operations, we aim to foster a responsible and sustainable business model that not only delivers quality products but also promotes social justice and human dignity at every level of our supply chain.
declaration.declaration: True Up Companies is committed to upholding labor and human rights across all operations and supply chains. We ensure fair wages, safe working conditions, and a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, forced labor, and child labor. By aligning with international labor standards, we foster an ethical, inclusive, and respectful work environment for all employees, partners, and stakeholders.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, contract workers, suppliers, and business partners, ensuring fair wages, safe working conditions, non-discrimination, and the prohibition of forced and child labor across True Up Companies’ operations and supply chain.

focusAreas: Prevention of Child and Forced Labor

Safe and Healthy Working Conditions: Maintain fair wages, reasonable working hours, and adequate rest periods in compliance with Labor laws.
Prohibit exploitative practices, including excessive overtime or unsafe working conditions.
Ensure warehouse, delivery, and remote work environments meet high Labor standards.
Prevention of Child and Forced Labor: Enforce a strict zero-tolerance policy on child Labor, forced Labor, and human trafficking within True-Up Companies and our supply chain.
Conduct regular audits and due diligence to ensure suppliers and third-party vendors comply with international Labor standards.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI): Foster a workplace culture that values diversity, equity, and inclusion across all levels of the organization.
Ensure hiring, promotions, and workplace policies are free from discrimination based on gender, race, age, disability, sexual orientation, or other protected characteristics.
Support initiatives that advance gender equality, accessibility, and representation in e-commerce and logistics roles.
Employee Health & Safety: Ensure a safe and healthy workplace across warehouses and offices.
Implement industry-leading safety protocols, regular risk assessments, and emergency preparedness training.
Provide necessary protective equipment, ergonomic workspaces, and wellness programs for all employees.
Social Dialogue & Employee Engagement: Promote open communication between employees, management, and stakeholders to address workplace concerns.
Support workers’ rights to collective bargaining and union participation without fear of retaliation.
Implement grievance mechanisms that allow employees to report concerns confidentially and without reprisal.
Career Growth & Skills Development: Provide training and career development programs to support employee growth and skills enhancement.
Encourage leadership development, mentorship, and internal mobility opportunities.
Ensure fair promotion and career advancement based on merit and performance.
Human Rights & Stakeholder Responsibilit: Engage with suppliers, third-party vendors, and business partners to uphold human rights across the supply chain.
Require suppliers to adhere to fair Labor practices, safe working conditions, and ethical business conduct.
Promote transparency and accountability by regularly assessing and improving human rights compliance efforts.
Working Hours and Overtime: Regularly monitor working hours to ensure compliance with labor laws.
Offer overtime opportunities only with proper compensation and consent.
Ensure work schedules are optimized to prevent burnout and fatigue.
Offer flexible working hours to promote a better work-life balance.
Mental Health: Launch mental health awareness campaigns to reduce stigma and encourage seeking support.
Provide access to professional counseling services for employees.
Establish programs for stress management and mindfulness.
Promote a culture of empathy and support for employee mental health.
Conduct surveys to assess the mental well-being of employees regularly.

responsibilities.duty: It ensures compliance with labor laws, provides necessary training, and fosters a safe and inclusive work environment.
It monitors adherence, conducts audits, and addresses concerns related to labor and human rights.
They are expected to align with True Up Companies ethical standards and labor policies.
They must follow the policy, report violations, and promote a culture of respect and fairness.

policy.reviewMechanism: The Labor and Human Rights Policy will be reviewed annually by the Human Resources Manager to ensure compliance with evolving regulations, industry best practices, and international standards. A designated compliance officer will oversee implementation, monitor adherence, and address concerns. Regular audits, employee feedback mechanisms, and supplier assessments will be conducted to identify gaps and drive continuous improvements. Any necessary updates will be approved by senior management and communicated across all levels of the organization and supply chain.
